title: Onboarding Hearing Transcript
description: Confirmed answers from an onboarding hearing, keyed by catalog item id.

version.description: Semantic version of the transcript document shape.

confirmedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the operator confirmed this transcript.

answers.description: One confirmed value per catalog item that was asked.

id.description: Catalog item id this answer belongs to.

value.description: Confirmed answer; for enum items this is an options.value.
